name: fin
description: Ask Claude about your bank balances, spending, subscriptions, and cash flow. Data stays on your computer.
long_description:
fin syncs your bank accounts through your own Plaid account into a local database on this computer, then lets Claude answer questions about balances, spending, recurring charges, credit cards, and cash flow.

**Setup:** create a free Plaid account (Trial plan), copy your Client ID and Production secret from the Plaid Dashboard into this extension's settings, then ask Claude to "connect my bank". You sign in to your bank in the browser; Claude never sees your bank login.

No money movement and no bank-write endpoints. Access tokens are encrypted with a key in your OS keychain. Results you ask about are sent to Claude's model provider. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Plaid.

plaid_client_id.title: Plaid Client ID
plaid_client_id.description: From the Plaid Dashboard: Developers > Keys.

plaid_secret.title: Plaid Secret
plaid_secret.description: The Production secret from Developers > Keys (or the Sandbox secret if Environment is sandbox). Stored in your OS keychain.

plaid_env.title: Environment
plaid_env.description: production for real bank accounts (including the free Trial plan), or sandbox for fake test data.
